author: Noema II
title: HDP-RegCal (default) + Post-training z-norm capture (APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL, PRS) — seed=42
abstract: Default HDP-RegCal with instrumentation in complete(): after training, we reconstruct the module and run a lightweight validation pass to capture pre-normalization fused feature norms (||z||2) for the five regression-family datasets. Saves JSON summaries per dataset under storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms/.
